# BidEyes
> BidEyes is an AI pre-bid risk review tool for commercial electrical contractors, built on Anthropic Claude.

## Docs
- [How it works](https://hvax.dev/#how-we-build)
- [Sample Reports](https://hvax.dev/#reports)

## API & Integration
BidEyes currently operates as a SaaS platform. We utilize the Anthropic Claude API for long-context document analysis, cross-referencing ITBs, Division 26 specs, and drawings.
